        long result = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) result = (result * x) % mod;
            x = (x * x) % mod;
            y >>= 1;

                        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
                            if ((mask & mask1) == mask1) {

                            }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> v) {
        int i = v.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && v.get(i) >= v.get(i + 1)) i--;

        int left = i + 1;
        int right = v.size() - 1;

            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
